Legal

Legal center

Last updated November 8, 2026

The terms, policies, and agreements that govern rempo.io and Rempo's services, in plain words where we can. Rempo is based in San Diego, California.

For everyone

  • Terms of ServiceThe agreement for using Rempo's website, the free Gap Report and Scorecard, and Rempo's paid services.
  • Privacy PolicyWhat personal information Rempo collects, why, who we share it with, and the choices and rights you have, including under California law.
  • Cookie and Tracking NoticeEach cookie, pixel, and browser storage item our pages use, what it does, and how to turn it off.
  • Your Privacy ChoicesOpt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information, and allow or decline advertising and analytics tools.
  • SMS and Messaging TermsHow Rempo's own text messages work, how review-request texts sent for our clients work, how to opt out, and the consent wording clients use.
  • Accessibility StatementRempo's commitment to accessible pages, what we have done, and how to reach us if something doesn't work for you.

For clients

  • Acceptable Use and Review Integrity PolicyThe rules every client and user follows, built on Google's review policies, the FTC's rule on consumer reviews, and the texting rules.
  • Data Processing AddendumHow Rempo protects the customer data it processes for clients, including the service provider terms California law requires.
  • Business Associate AgreementThe HIPAA business associate terms for healthcare practices that send Rempo patient contact information.
  • Subprocessors and Service ProvidersThe companies that help Rempo run its website and services, what each one does, and what information it handles.
  • Billing, Renewal, and Cancellation PolicyHow Rempo charges for its services, how renewals work, how to cancel online at any time, and when refunds apply.

Contact

  • Privacy requests: privacy@rempo.io
  • Support, billing, and cancellation: support@rempo.io
  • Legal notices: legal@rempo.io
